title: Admin password minimum length enforced
remediation:
config system password-policy
  set status enable
  set minimum-length 14
end

title: Admin password policy enforces character-type complexity
remediation:
config system password-policy
  set status enable
  set min-lower-case-letter 1
  set min-upper-case-letter 1
  set min-number 1
  set min-non-alphanumeric 1
end

title: Admin lockout threshold and duration configured
remediation:
config system global
  set admin-lockout-threshold 3
  set admin-lockout-duration 60
end

title: Administrative idle timeout set to <=5 minutes
remediation:
config system global
  set admintimeout 5
end

title: Only HTTPS/SSH (not HTTP/Telnet) permitted for admin access on interfaces
remediation:
config system interface
  edit <interface>
    unset allowaccess   ! then re-add only https, ssh (and ping if needed)
    set allowaccess https ssh
  next
end

title: Default 'admin' account renamed, disabled, or restricted by trusted hosts
remediation:
config system admin
  edit admin
    set trusthost1 <mgmt-subnet>/<mask>
  next
end
! or rename via GUI/API (rename not supported directly in CLI - create a new named admin with same rights and disable/delete 'admin')

title: Pre-login administrative disclaimer/banner configured
remediation:
config system global
  set pre-login-banner enable
end
config system replacemsg admin pre_admin-disclaimer-text
  set buffer "Authorized users only. All activity may be monitored and reported."
end

title: Auto-install of configuration/firmware from USB is disabled
remediation:
config system auto-install
  set auto-install-config disable
  set auto-install-image disable
end

title: SNMP restricted to v3 (no v1/v2c communities), or disabled
remediation:
config system snmp sysinfo
  set status disable   ! if SNMP unused, else configure snmpv3 only
end
config system snmp community
  ! remove all v1/v2c communities
end

title: NTP synchronization enabled (accurate log timestamps)
remediation:
config system ntp
  set ntpsync enable
  set type custom
  ! set trusted NTP servers
end

title: Event logging enabled to a remote target (FortiAnalyzer/syslog)
expected: remote logging enabled with server set
remediation:
config log syslogd setting
  set status enable
  set server <syslog-server-ip>
end
